proof_body:
by
  intro K _ I hI
  obtain ⟨⟨g, hg⟩⟩ := IsPrincipalIdealRing.principal I
  have hg' : I = Ideal.span {g} := hg
  have hg0 : g ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; apply hI; rw [hg']; simp
  refine ⟨g * Polynomial.C g.leadingCoeff⁻¹, ⟨Polynomial.monic_mul_leadingCoeff_inv hg0, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · rw [hg']
    have hu : IsUnit (Polynomial.C g.leadingCoeff⁻¹) := Polynomial.isUnit_C.mpr (IsUnit.mk0 _ (inv_ne_zero (Polynomial.leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hg0)))
    exact (Ideal.span_singleton_mul_right_unit hu g).symm
  · rintro f ⟨hf, hfI⟩
    have hm : g * Polynomial.C g.leadingCoeff⁻¹ ∈ Ideal.span {f} := by
      rw [← hfI, hg']; exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self g)
    have hm2 : f ∈ Ideal.span {g} := by rw [← hg', hfI]; exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self f
    have d1 : f ∣ g * Polynomial.C g.leadingCoeff⁻¹ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp hm
    have hu : IsUnit (Polynomial.C g.leadingCoeff⁻¹) := Polynomial.isUnit_C.mpr (IsUnit.mk0 _ (inv_ne_zero (Polynomial.leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hg0)))
    have d2 : g * Polynomial.C g.leadingCoeff⁻¹ ∣ f := by
      have := Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp hm2
      obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := this
      obtain ⟨u, hu'⟩ := hu
      refine ⟨↑u⁻¹ * w, ?_⟩
      rw [← hu', mul_assoc, Units.mul_inv_cancel_left, hw]
    exact Polynomial.eq_of_monic_of_associated hf (Polynomial.monic_mul_leadingCoeff_inv hg0) (associated_of_dvd_dvd d1 d2)
target_source: ∀ (K : Type*) [Field K] (I : Ideal (Polynomial K)), I ≠ ⊥ → ∃! f : Polynomial K, f.Monic ∧ I = Ideal.span {f}
